C0870.title: China's First Bitcoin Ransomware Case Cracked
C0870.summary: The developer behind the nation's first bitcoin ransomware, identified as Ju, was arrested by police. Over three years, Ju used self-developed ransomware to attack more than 400 websites and computer systems, encrypting files and demanding bitcoin ransoms, with illegal profits exceeding 5 million yuan. Victims included supermarkets and listed companies; one listed company suffered a three-day shut
